title: AppX vs Classplus (2026): Prices, Fees and Which to Pick
description: AppX vs Classplus for coaching educators: Classplus lists ₹29,999 a year, AppX lists no price. What each offers, what to ask in the demo, and a third option.
og_description: Classplus lists ₹29,999 a year; AppX shows no price on its site. A fair, sourced comparison of both coaching app platforms, the questions to ask before you sign, and when a self-serve academy fits better.
h1: AppX vs Classplus (2026): Prices, Fees and Which One to Pick for Your Coaching
dek: A fair head-to-head of two coaching app platforms: what each one says it does, what each one publishes about price, the questions to ask before you sign, and where a self-serve academy fits instead.
cover_alt: AppX vs Classplus: which coaching app platform to pick, with prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Coaching institute owners and independent educators in India choosing between AppX and Classplus
intro: AppX vs Classplus comes down to how you want your app built and how much you want to know about price before you talk to sales. AppX sets up a branded website and app for you, which its site says is delivered in days, but it lists no price. Classplus lists ₹29,999 for one year and ₹39,999 for two years, but does not state GST, any fee on your sales or the renewal price. If you would rather build the academy yourself, with a published price and a free trial, AllCoaching is a third option worth comparing.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every AppX and Classplus fact below comes from that company's own website, with the link and the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026). Where the website is silent, we say so and turn it into a question you can ask in the demo.
Both companies help Indian educators run coaching under their own name. The differences are in how you start, what you can see before you sign, and who controls the app once it is live.
takeaways: Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year and ₹39,999 for 2 years on classplusapp.com/new-web (checked 24 Oct 2026); GST, any fee on sales and the renewal price are not stated there.
AppX lists no price on its website (appx.co.in, checked 24 Oct 2026); pricing starts with a free personalised demo.
AppX's strength is a done-for-you setup: its site says "Setup in under 48 hours" and that the finished app and website are delivered in 3-5 days.
Neither site says how renewals are charged, so ask both for a written yearly quote, renewal price and any fee on sales before you compare.
AllCoaching publishes its price: Starter ₹6,999, Growth ₹12,999 or Pro ₹24,999 a year plus a 10%, 7.5% or 5% fee on sales, GST extra, with a 14-day free trial and no card.
On published prices, AllCoaching costs less than Classplus up to about ₹2.3 lakh of sales a year; above that, Classplus's listed price is lower on paper.
You can move later without losing students by running the old and new platforms side by side until the current batch ends.

sections.h2: AppX vs Classplus: the short answer
sections.html:
Pick AppX if you want a team to set up your app and website for you and you are comfortable getting the price in a demo. Pick Classplus if you want a listed yearly price and an established coaching app. Pick a self-serve academy if you want to build and change everything yourself.

{{fig:verdict|AppX vs Classplus, which to choose by need: done-for-you setup, AppX; a listed flat yearly price, Classplus; build your own website and app yourself, AllCoaching; still unsure, ask both for written quotes|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each one.}}

None of these is the right answer for everyone. The sections below show what each company publishes, what it leaves out, and how to compare the two quotes you will get.

sections.h2: How we compared AppX and Classplus
sections.html:
We read each company's own website on 24 Oct 2026 and compared the five things a coaching owner pays for or depends on.

  1. Price you can see before signing up, taken only from the official site.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. How you start: a demo and sales conversation, or a self-serve sign-up.
  4. What you get: website, Android and iOS app, live classes, courses and tests.
  5. Who controls changes after launch: you in a studio, or the vendor's team.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide and is a third option in the same decision. AppX and Classplus figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: What AppX and Classplus each offer, in their own words
sections.html:
AppX and Classplus solve the same problem, getting a coaching business online under its own name, but they describe themselves differently.

AppX: a branded app and website, set up for you

AppX says: "Launch your own branded app and website for your courses and community. No code needed." Its site describes branded apps on Android, iOS and desktop, DRM security for videos and low-latency live streaming.[2]

Its clearest strength is speed with little effort from you. The homepage says "Setup in under 48 hours", and its FAQ says "It takes 3-5 days to deliver your finished application and website". For an owner who never wants to touch settings, a team that builds it for you is real value.

Classplus: a coaching app and website with a listed yearly price

Classplus says: "Get your own brand's teaching app, create your own website & sell courses". Its plan lists an Android app, a website, an admin portal, unlimited recorded courses, live classes, student enrolments and storage, plus "A.I. Powered Leads".[1]

Classplus is one of the better-known names in Indian coaching apps, and it now publishes its price: ₹29,999 for one year and ₹39,999 for two years, shown against struck-through prices of ₹34,999 and ₹44,999.

{{q:Is AppX a one-time payment?|AppX does not say on its website. It lists no price and no plan table, and pricing starts with a free personalised demo. Ask in writing whether the quote is a one-time build fee, a yearly renewal or both, what the renewal costs, and what happens to your app and website if you stop paying.}}

The same question applies to Classplus. Its pricing page has an FAQ titled "What are the renewal charges?", but the answer was not in the page when we checked. Ask for it.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: coaching run across WhatsApp, Google Drive, UPI screenshots and a separate live-class app, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes and checkout|Whichever platform you pick, the goal is the same: one place for courses, students and payments.}}

sections.h2: Which costs less, AppX or Classplus?
sections.html:
We cannot say which costs less, because AppX does not publish a price. The only honest way to compare is to get AppX's written quote and set it against Classplus's listed price at your own sales level.

What we can show is Classplus next to AllCoaching, since both publish prices. The chart adds each plan price to its fee on sales at five sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan each time.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at sales levels up to ₹10 lakh from published prices for AllCoaching and Classplus; AppX is not shown because it lists no price|Before GST. Classplus's line is its listed price only, because its pricing page does not state a fee on sales.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: up to about ₹2.3 lakh of sales a year, AllCoaching costs less on published prices, because its Starter plan is ₹6,999 and the fee applies only when you sell. Above that, Classplus's ₹29,999 is lower on paper, as long as Classplus confirms there is no fee on sales and tells you the renewal price. Classplus's two-year price of ₹39,999 lowers its yearly cost further if you are sure you will stay two years.

When AppX sends its quote, add any setup fee, the yearly or renewal amount and any fee on sales, then compare the total at your real sales level. Use our plan finder for the AllCoaching side, and our guide to white-label coaching app costs in India for the line items to ask about.

sections.h2: What to ask AppX and Classplus before you sign
sections.html:
Ask both companies the same questions and get the answers in writing. That turns two demos into two quotes you can actually compare.

  1. What is the total price for year one, including GST and any setup fee?
  2. What does renewal cost in year two and year three?
  3. Is any percentage or fee taken on my course sales? Ask about payment gateway charges separately.
  4. Are both the Android and the iOS app included, and under whose developer account are they published?
  5. Can I connect my own domain to the website?
  6. Who makes changes after launch: can I edit courses, prices and pages myself, or do I raise a request?
  7. If I stop paying, what happens to the app, the website and my student data? Can I export students, payments and content?

We ask ourselves the same questions. Our answers are on the pricing page: one published yearly plan, every plan includes your own domain and your own Android and iOS app, and your data stays exportable.

sections.h2: AppX or Classplus: which fits your coaching
sections.html:
You want it done for you

If you teach full time and do not want to learn any software, AppX's done-for-you setup is its main advantage. Budget time for the demo and get the quote, renewal and change process in writing.

You are an established institute with steady sales

If you already sell well above ₹2.3 lakh a year, Classplus's flat listed price can cost less than a percentage model. Confirm GST, fees on sales and renewal first. Our guide to the best LMS for coaching institutes covers more options at this size.

You are starting out or growing (under ₹2 lakh a year)

A low fixed price and a free trial matter more than anything else here. A self-serve academy lets you build, test with one batch and sell before paying much. Start with how to sell courses online in India.

You want your own domain and brand above all

For an SSC maths educator growing on YouTube, or a yoga teacher selling a 30-day course, the academy on your own domain is the asset that lasts. See LMS with a custom domain.

You already have an app and nobody downloads it

A new platform will not fix that alone. Read why a coaching app gets no students before you switch.

sections.h2: How to move from AppX or Classplus later without losing students
sections.html:
Whichever you choose now, you can move later without losing students if you run both platforms side by side. Current students stay where they are until their batch ends; new admissions go to the new academy.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to move from AppX or Classplus: build your academy, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old plan after the last batch|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice for long.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Start the 14-day trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course with a free demo lesson.

Keep current students on AppX or Classplus until their batch or validity ends, so nobody loses access.
Send new admissions to your academy
Share your own website and app link on WhatsApp, YouTube and Instagram for every new batch.
Export records and close the old plan
Download student and payment records, then let the old plan end at renewal.

faq: What is the main difference between AppX and Classplus?

AppX sets up a branded website and app for you and lists no price on its website, while Classplus lists ₹29,999 for one year and ₹39,999 for two years. Both give you a branded coaching app and website; they differ in how you start and what they publish before you sign.

AppX does not say on its website, which lists no price and starts with a free personalised demo (checked 24 Oct 2026). Ask in writing whether the quote is a one-time build fee, a yearly renewal or both, and what happens to your app if you stop paying.
Which is cheaper, AppX or Classplus?

It cannot be compared from public information, because AppX publishes no price. Get AppX's written quote, including any setup fee, renewal and fee on sales, and compare it with Classplus's listed ₹29,999 a year after asking Classplus about GST and fees.
How much does Classplus cost in 2026?
Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year and ₹39,999 for 2 years on classplusapp.com/new-web (checked 24 Oct 2026). The page does not state GST, any fee on sales or the renewal price.
Does AppX or Classplus bring students to my coaching?

Both are tools for running your own coaching app; finding students stays mainly your job through YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and referrals. Classplus lists A.I. Powered Leads on its plan, so ask what that includes.
What should I ask before signing with AppX or Classplus?

Ask for the year-one total with GST, the renewal price, any fee on sales, whether Android and iOS apps are included and under whose account, whether you can use your own domain, who makes changes after launch, and what you can export if you leave.
How is AllCoaching different from AppX and Classplus?

AllCoaching is self-serve: you build your academy yourself with a 14-day free trial and no card, then choose Starter ₹6,999, Growth ₹12,999 or Pro ₹24,999 a year plus a 10%, 7.5% or 5% fee on sales. Every plan includes your own domain and your own Android and iOS app.
Can I move from AppX or Classplus to another platform later?
Yes. Build the new academy, keep current students on the old platform until their batch ends, send new admissions to the new one, then export records and let the old plan end at renewal.
